analysis.metric: sum(cached_tokens) / sum(prompt_tokens) over valid reported usage
analysis.proxy_definition: current cached_tokens / previous prompt_tokens; this is a historical-prefix coverage proxy, not the current-request hit rate
analysis.zero_cache_locations: runtime epoch 1, waves 5 and 6, after the interrupted process was restored
analysis.interpretation: Late windows in this finite growing-history replay are near 98%; unknown or absent usage is excluded, not counted as zero. The run does not establish an infinite-history steady state, upstream cache TTL, or behavior after context compaction. Route labels are local to each runtime epoch.

limitations: Endpoint-reported cached_tokens; upstream cache state and internal routing remain unobserved.
Four isolated topic copies of one chronological cached stream, not 6144 distinct messages.
Message dates and ids are remapped for fresh ingestion; original cached text remains unchanged.
Existing recorded-event replay reconstructs media by reference; media bytes are not fetched.
Existing replay loader does not restore all original Telegram reply/entity metadata.
Production output budget retained; previous short synthetic benchmark capped output at 512.
Latency is non-streaming round trip; operator gaps between control chunks are excluded from active replay time.
No TTL or eviction test and no guarantee that finite history growth predicts unbounded steady state.
Process interruption after wave 4: committed provider usage recovered where available; unknown outcomes are excluded from token totals.
